title: Shallow-water tethered live-camera ROV
engineering: 64 freshwater displacement and tolerance cases. The larger float pair retained 42.66 g minimum upward reserve under the assumed equipped mass and tether load.
physical_check: Weigh the complete vehicle and submerged tether and test static trim and recovery in a contained tank. Check real sealed components independently.

title: Assembled SO-101 follower arm
engineering: Replayed the upstream URDF in two cold bench layouts. A 1.5 degree shoulder zero error missed the revised position target by up to 4.79 mm.
physical_check: Verify the exact servos and zero calibration. Measure repeatability and loaded pallet clearance on an actual assembled arm.
